mentions.name: Prompt Shuttle
mentions.description: A prompt manager positioned as agents-as-a-service, offered via an API rather than an SDK. Work is underway to make it more usable and flexible, with the website, UI and onboarding still needing improvement.
mentions.source_excerpt: I re-visited my prompt manager and asked the question: what does it even do differently? I realized it's agents-as-a-service / as an API rather than an SDK. Now looking into making it a lot more usable and flexible, but the website, UI and onboarding need work: https://www.promptshuttle.com
